Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction).name: Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction)
Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction).description: A serious medical emergency where blood flow to the heart muscle is severely reduced or blocked.
Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction).recommendation: Call 911 or visit the nearest Emergency Room IMMEDIATELY. Do not attempt to drive yourself.
Heart Attack (Myocardial Infarction).explanation_template: Symptoms strongly align with Myocardial Infarction due to acute chest discomfort radiating to upper body accompanied by breathlessness.

Stroke (Cerebrovascular Accident).name: Stroke (Cerebrovascular Accident)
Stroke (Cerebrovascular Accident).description: Interruption of blood supply to the brain causing sudden neurological deficits.
Stroke (Cerebrovascular Accident).recommendation: Call 911 IMMEDIATELY. Remember FAST (Face, Arms, Speech, Time). Time is critical for clot-busting treatment.
Stroke (Cerebrovascular Accident).explanation_template: Combination of acute neurological symptoms (facial droop, speech impairment, arm weakness) indicates possible ischemic stroke.

Sepsis.name: Sepsis
Sepsis.description: Life-threatening organ dysfunction caused by a dysregulated host response to infection.
Sepsis.recommendation: Seek immediate emergency medical evaluation. Sepsis requires urgent IV antibiotics and hospital care.
Sepsis.explanation_template: Systemic inflammatory features including high fever, tachycardia, altered mental state, and rigors signal potential septic reaction.

Severe Pneumonia.name: Severe Pneumonia
Severe Pneumonia.description: Severe lung infection causing inflammation in air sacs and compromised oxygenation.
Severe Pneumonia.recommendation: Go to the Emergency Department immediately. Supplemental oxygen and intensive antimicrobial treatment may be needed.
Severe Pneumonia.explanation_template: Severe respiratory distress, productive cough with high fever and hypoxia symptoms match severe lower respiratory tract infection.

Pulmonary Embolism.name: Pulmonary Embolism
Pulmonary Embolism.description: A blockage in one of the pulmonary arteries in your lungs, usually caused by blood clots from legs.
Pulmonary Embolism.recommendation: Call emergency services immediately. Pulmonary embolism requires prompt anticoagulation and monitoring.
Pulmonary Embolism.explanation_template: Acute onset of sharp chest pain with hemoptysis and dyspnea strongly suggests pulmonary arterial thromboembolism.

Acute Appendicitis.name: Acute Appendicitis
Acute Appendicitis.description: Acute inflammation of the appendix with high risk of rupture and peritonitis.
Acute Appendicitis.recommendation: Visit an emergency room for surgical evaluation. Do not take laxatives or apply heat pads.
Acute Appendicitis.explanation_template: Migration of abdominal pain to the right lower quadrant accompanied by fever and rebound tenderness is classic for appendicitis.

Anaphylaxis.name: Anaphylaxis
Anaphylaxis.description: Severe, potentially life-threatening systemic allergic reaction.
Anaphylaxis.recommendation: Administer epinephrine autoinjector (EpiPen) immediately if available and call 911 right away.
Anaphylaxis.explanation_template: Rapid onset multi-organ allergic response involving airway compromise and cutaneous symptoms matches anaphylaxis.

Meningitis.name: Meningitis
Meningitis.description: Inflammation of the protective membranes covering the brain and spinal cord.
Meningitis.recommendation: Seek emergency medical care immediately. Bacterial meningitis can progress rapidly and requires urgent IV antibiotics.
Meningitis.explanation_template: Meningeal triad of fever, severe headache, and neck stiffness combined with photophobia points towards meningitis.

Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).name: Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA)
Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).description: A serious metabolic complication of diabetes characterized by excessive ketones in the blood.
Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).recommendation: Go to the nearest emergency room immediately for fluid hydration and insulin therapy.
Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA).explanation_template: Kussmaul breathing, acetone breath odor, hyperosmolar symptoms, and abdominal pain are characteristic of diabetic ketoacidosis.

Hypertensive Crisis.name: Hypertensive Crisis
Hypertensive Crisis.description: A severe increase in blood pressure that can lead to stroke or end-organ damage.
Hypertensive Crisis.recommendation: Seek immediate emergency medical attention to lower blood pressure safely.
Hypertensive Crisis.explanation_template: Extreme blood pressure elevation symptoms including thunderclap headache, visual disturbances, and chest tightness require acute intervention.

Influenza (Flu).name: Influenza (Flu)
Influenza (Flu).description: Contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses.
Influenza (Flu).recommendation: Consult your General Practitioner (GP) within 24-48 hours. Rest, stay hydrated, and consider antiviral medication if advised.
Influenza (Flu).explanation_template: Acute onset of high fever, widespread myalgia, fatigue, and non-productive cough strongly fits Influenza infection.

COVID-19.name: COVID-19
COVID-19.description: Viral infection caused by SARS-CoV-2 targeting the respiratory system.
COVID-19.recommendation: Isolate, perform an antigen test, and consult a doctor if symptoms worsen or risk factors exist.
COVID-19.explanation_template: Anosmia/ageusia combined with fever and upper respiratory viral symptoms matches COVID-19 profile.

Migraine.name: Migraine
Migraine.description: Neurological condition causing intense throbbing headache, often on one side.
Migraine.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor for targeted prescription triptans or preventive migraine therapy.
Migraine.explanation_template: Unilateral pulsatile headache exacerbated by light/sound and accompanied by nausea aligns with migraine.

Gastritis / Peptic Ulcer.name: Gastritis / Peptic Ulcer
Gastritis / Peptic Ulcer.description: Inflammation or erosion of the stomach lining causing upper abdominal discomfort.
Gastritis / Peptic Ulcer.recommendation: Schedule an appointment with a GP or gastroenterologist. Avoid spicy/fatty foods and NSAID painkillers.
Gastritis / Peptic Ulcer.explanation_template: Epigastric burning discomfort exacerbated or relieved by food indicates gastric mucosal irritation.

Hypertension (Uncontrolled).name: Hypertension (Uncontrolled)
Hypertension (Uncontrolled).description: Chronically elevated blood pressure requiring clinical evaluation and blood pressure tracking.
Hypertension (Uncontrolled).recommendation: Book a GP appointment to check blood pressure readings and adjust antihypertensive therapy.
Hypertension (Uncontrolled).explanation_template: Persistent morning occipital headaches with dizziness in the absence of acute emergency red flags suggest uncontrolled hypertension.

Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).description: Bacterial infection in any part of the urinary system, commonly bladder and urethra.
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).recommendation: Consult a physician within 24 hours for urine analysis and targeted antibiotic treatment.
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI).explanation_template: Dysuria, urinary frequency, and cloudy urine strongly correlate with lower urinary tract bacterial infection.

Acute Bronchitis.name: Acute Bronchitis
Acute Bronchitis.description: Inflammation of the bronchial tubes leading to persistent cough and chest congestion.
Acute Bronchitis.recommendation: Consult a doctor if cough lasts > 2 weeks or produces thick purulent sputum. Rest and use bronchodilators as advised.
Acute Bronchitis.explanation_template: Persistent cough producing mucus accompanied by bronchial wheezing points toward acute tracheobronchitis.

Sinusitis.name: Sinusitis
Sinusitis.description: Inflammation of sinus cavities causing facial pressure and purulent nasal discharge.
Sinusitis.recommendation: Consult a doctor if symptoms persist over 10 days or worsen after initial improvement.
Sinusitis.explanation_template: Maxillary/frontal facial pressure with purulent nasal discharge fits acute paranasal sinusitis.

Strep Throat (Tonsillitis).name: Strep Throat (Tonsillitis)
Strep Throat (Tonsillitis).description: Bacterial pharyngitis caused by Streptococcus pyogenes.
Strep Throat (Tonsillitis).recommendation: Visit a doctor for a rapid strep swab test and prescription oral antibiotic regimen.
Strep Throat (Tonsillitis).explanation_template: Exudative tonsillitis with tender cervical lymphadenopathy and absence of cough indicates bacterial streptococcal pharyngitis.

Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis).name: Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis)
Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis).description: Hard mineral deposits formed inside kidneys passing through urinary tract.
Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis).recommendation: Consult a GP or urologist promptly for pain relief, ultrasound evaluation, and stone management.
Kidney Stones (Nephrolithiasis).explanation_template: Colicky flank pain radiating groinward accompanied by hematuria fits renal colic secondary to nephrolithiasis.

Common Cold.name: Common Cold
Common Cold.description: Mild viral upper respiratory infection resolving spontaneously.
Common Cold.recommendation: Rest well, drink warm fluids, use saline nasal sprays, and monitor symptoms. Typically resolves in 7-10 days.
Common Cold.explanation_template: Mild upper respiratory symptoms (rhinorrhea, sneezing, scratchy throat) without high fever align with common cold.

Seasonal Allergies (Allergic Rhinitis).name: Seasonal Allergies (Allergic Rhinitis)
Seasonal Allergies (Allergic Rhinitis).description: Allergic response to airborne environmental allergens like pollen, dust mites, or pet dander.
Seasonal Allergies (Allergic Rhinitis).recommendation: Over-the-counter antihistamines, nasal corticosteroid spray, avoiding allergen exposure.
Seasonal Allergies (Allergic Rhinitis).explanation_template: Pruritic ocular/nasal symptoms with clear rhinorrhea triggered environmentally indicate allergic rhinitis.

Tension Headache.name: Tension Headache
Tension Headache.description: Common headache characterized by a dull, aching band-like pain around the head.
Tension Headache.recommendation: Practice stress reduction, stay hydrated, get adequate sleep, and use mild OTC pain relievers if necessary.
Tension Headache.explanation_template: Bilateral band-like pressure headache without neurological focal signs fits tension-type headache.

Mild Dehydration / Heat Fatigue.name: Mild Dehydration / Heat Fatigue
Mild Dehydration / Heat Fatigue.description: Inadequate body fluid balance causing temporary lethargy, dryness, and lightheadedness.
Mild Dehydration / Heat Fatigue.recommendation: Rehydrate with water and oral rehydration electrolyte solutions. Rest in a cool place.
Mild Dehydration / Heat Fatigue.explanation_template: Thirst, concentrated urine, xerostomia, and mild lethargy reflect low fluid volume.

Muscle Strain (Myalgia).name: Muscle Strain (Myalgia)
Muscle Strain (Myalgia).description: Stretching or tearing of muscle fibers or tendons following physical activity.
Muscle Strain (Myalgia).recommendation: Follow R.I.C.E. protocol (Rest, Ice, Compression, Elevation). Gentle stretching.
Muscle Strain (Myalgia).explanation_template: Focal tender muscle discomfort following exertion corresponds to minor muscular strain.

Mild Gastric Indigestion (Dyspepsia).name: Mild Gastric Indigestion (Dyspepsia)
Mild Gastric Indigestion (Dyspepsia).description: Transient discomfort in the upper abdomen associated with dietary triggers.
Mild Gastric Indigestion (Dyspepsia).recommendation: Eat smaller meals, avoid reclining immediately after eating, and try OTC antacids if needed.
Mild Gastric Indigestion (Dyspepsia).explanation_template: Self-limiting postprandial fullness and mild heartburn fits functional dyspepsia.

Dengue Fever.name: Dengue Fever
Dengue Fever.description: Medical condition involving dengue fever presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Dengue Fever.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Dengue Fever.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring high fever, severe behind eye pain strongly aligns with Dengue Fever.

Malaria.name: Malaria
Malaria.description: Medical condition involving malaria presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Malaria.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Malaria.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring chills and rigors, high fever strongly aligns with Malaria.

Gout Flare.name: Gout Flare
Gout Flare.description: Medical condition involving gout flare presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Gout Flare.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Gout Flare.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring severe joint pain big toe, swollen red joint strongly aligns with Gout Flare.

Hypothyroidism.name: Hypothyroidism
Hypothyroidism.description: Medical condition involving hypothyroidism presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Hypothyroidism.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Hypothyroidism.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring unexplained weight gain, cold intolerance strongly aligns with Hypothyroidism.

Otitis Media (Ear Infection).name: Otitis Media (Ear Infection)
Otitis Media (Ear Infection).description: Medical condition involving otitis media (ear infection) presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Otitis Media (Ear Infection).recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Otitis Media (Ear Infection).explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring ear pain, fever strongly aligns with Otitis Media (Ear Infection).

Asthma Exacerbation.name: Asthma Exacerbation
Asthma Exacerbation.description: Medical condition involving asthma exacerbation presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Asthma Exacerbation.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Asthma Exacerbation.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring wheezing, chest tightness strongly aligns with Asthma Exacerbation.

Gallstones (Cholecystitis).name: Gallstones (Cholecystitis)
Gallstones (Cholecystitis).description: Medical condition involving gallstones (cholecystitis) presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Gallstones (Cholecystitis).recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Gallstones (Cholecystitis).explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring right upper quadrant pain, pain after fatty meals strongly aligns with Gallstones (Cholecystitis).

Depression / Anxiety Disorder.name: Depression / Anxiety Disorder
Depression / Anxiety Disorder.description: Medical condition involving depression / anxiety disorder presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Depression / Anxiety Disorder.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Depression / Anxiety Disorder.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring persistent sadness, anxiety strongly aligns with Depression / Anxiety Disorder.

Shingles (Herpes Zoster).name: Shingles (Herpes Zoster)
Shingles (Herpes Zoster).description: Medical condition involving shingles (herpes zoster) presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Shingles (Herpes Zoster).recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Shingles (Herpes Zoster).explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring painful blister rash one side, burning skin pain strongly aligns with Shingles (Herpes Zoster).

Iron Deficiency Anemia.name: Iron Deficiency Anemia
Iron Deficiency Anemia.description: Medical condition involving iron deficiency anemia presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Iron Deficiency Anemia.recommendation: Consult a primary care doctor within 24-48 hours.
Iron Deficiency Anemia.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring extreme fatigue, pale skin strongly aligns with Iron Deficiency Anemia.

Aortic Dissection.name: Aortic Dissection
Aortic Dissection.description: Medical condition involving aortic dissection presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Aortic Dissection.recommendation: Seek urgent emergency medical room attention immediately.
Aortic Dissection.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring sudden tearing chest pain, pain radiating to back strongly aligns with Aortic Dissection.

Acute Pancreatitis.name: Acute Pancreatitis
Acute Pancreatitis.description: Medical condition involving acute pancreatitis presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Acute Pancreatitis.recommendation: Seek urgent emergency medical room attention immediately.
Acute Pancreatitis.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring severe upper abdominal pain, pain radiating to back strongly aligns with Acute Pancreatitis.

Tension Pneumothorax.name: Tension Pneumothorax
Tension Pneumothorax.description: Medical condition involving tension pneumothorax presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Tension Pneumothorax.recommendation: Seek urgent emergency medical room attention immediately.
Tension Pneumothorax.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring sudden sharp chest pain, severe shortness of breath strongly aligns with Tension Pneumothorax.

Intracranial Hemorrhage.name: Intracranial Hemorrhage
Intracranial Hemorrhage.description: Medical condition involving intracranial hemorrhage presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Intracranial Hemorrhage.recommendation: Seek urgent emergency medical room attention immediately.
Intracranial Hemorrhage.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring sudden worst headache of life, loss of consciousness strongly aligns with Intracranial Hemorrhage.

Carbon Monoxide Poisoning.name: Carbon Monoxide Poisoning
Carbon Monoxide Poisoning.description: Medical condition involving carbon monoxide poisoning presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Carbon Monoxide Poisoning.recommendation: Seek urgent emergency medical room attention immediately.
Carbon Monoxide Poisoning.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring dizziness, confusion strongly aligns with Carbon Monoxide Poisoning.

Contact Dermatitis.name: Contact Dermatitis
Contact Dermatitis.description: Medical condition involving contact dermatitis presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Contact Dermatitis.recommendation: Rest, monitor symptoms, and use over-the-counter supportive care.
Contact Dermatitis.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring skin redness, itchy rash strongly aligns with Contact Dermatitis.

Minor Motion Sickness.name: Minor Motion Sickness
Minor Motion Sickness.description: Medical condition involving minor motion sickness presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Minor Motion Sickness.recommendation: Rest, monitor symptoms, and use over-the-counter supportive care.
Minor Motion Sickness.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring dizziness in vehicle, nausea strongly aligns with Minor Motion Sickness.

Mild Sunburn.name: Mild Sunburn
Mild Sunburn.description: Medical condition involving mild sunburn presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Mild Sunburn.recommendation: Rest, monitor symptoms, and use over-the-counter supportive care.
Mild Sunburn.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring red painful skin after sun, warm skin strongly aligns with Mild Sunburn.

Minor Food Intolerance.name: Minor Food Intolerance
Minor Food Intolerance.description: Medical condition involving minor food intolerance presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Minor Food Intolerance.recommendation: Rest, monitor symptoms, and use over-the-counter supportive care.
Minor Food Intolerance.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring mild bloating after dairy, gas strongly aligns with Minor Food Intolerance.

Mild Eye Strain.name: Mild Eye Strain
Mild Eye Strain.description: Medical condition involving mild eye strain presenting with characteristic symptoms.
Mild Eye Strain.recommendation: Rest, monitor symptoms, and use over-the-counter supportive care.
Mild Eye Strain.explanation_template: Clinical presentation featuring dry eyes, blurry vision after screens strongly aligns with Mild Eye Strain.
